"./common/shared.js"(__unused_rspack_module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {

  commonFunction: () => (commonFunction)

	return `Updated common function: ${input}`;

### main.LAST_HASH.hot-update.mjs

#### Changed Modules


#### Changed Runtime Modules
- webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
- webpack/runtime/hot_module_replacement_chunk_versions

#### Changed Content
```js
export const __rspack_esm_ids = ["main"];
export const __webpack_modules__ = {};
export const __rspack_esm_runtime = function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();
// webpack/runtime/hot_module_replacement_chunk_versions
(() => {
[["common","CHUNK_VERSION"],["vendor","CHUNK_VERSION"]].forEach(function(entry) { if (entry[1] === null) delete __webpack_require__.hmrV[entry[0]]; else __webpack_require__.hmrV[entry[0]] = entry[1]; });
})();

}
;

```

export const __rspack_esm_ids = ["vendor"];

const vendorLib = {
	version: "2.0.0",
	init: function() {
		console.log("Vendor lib initialized v2");
	}
};
